question_text: Select the synonym of ABUNDANT.
explanation: Abundant' means existing or available in large quantities; more than adequate. 'Plentiful' carries the same meaning - present in large amounts or numbers. 'Scarce', 'rare', and 'limited' are all antonyms of abundant, as they indicate insufficient quantity or availability. When something is abundant or plentiful, there is plenty of it available, often more than needed. This makes 'plentiful' the perfect synonym.

Only future perfect correctly shows completion before a future time point.
